property_summary: For every caller address, invoking owned() must not succeed when the caller is not the current owner (i.e., only the owner can successfully call owned()); the mutant removing the require allows a non-owner call to succeed and thus can change owner-visible state for some caller.
change_summary: Remove the require check from onlyOwner so owned() can be called by anyone, allowing owner to be changed by non-owners if owned() modifies owner.
